name: Vala Leikskóli
tagline: Daily updates, menus and preschool messages in Vala
description: Keep up with your child’s preschool day in Vala: meals, sleep, attendance, menus, events and messages from staff. You can also report illness or planned absence if you enable changes.
examples: How well did my child eat lunch this week?
What's on the preschool calendar this month?
Let the preschool know my child is sick today.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Signed-in parent: name, email, language (kennitala and phone omitted).

tools.name: kids
tools.description: Children on the account with school and opening hours.

tools.name: lunch
tools.description: Lunch menu and eat rating per child for a date or the 7 days ending on it.

tools.name: attendance
tools.description: Arrival/departure, sleep, eat rating and staff comments for a day.

tools.name: today
tools.description: Today's attendance plus each school's menu.

tools.name: events
tools.description: School calendar events for a date range (default next 30 days).

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Latest chat messages between parent and school per child.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Login state, token expiry, API reachability and visible children.

tools.name: register_absence
tools.description: Register a sick or vacation absence for a child (requires confirm: true).

envVars.name: VALA_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose register_absence in the MCP server.

envVars.name: VALA_ENV
envVars.description: Set to test to use the Vala test backend.

is.tagline: Daglegar upplýsingar, matseðlar og skilaboð úr Völu
is.description: Fylgstu með leikskóladeginum í Völu: hvernig barnið borðaði og svaf, mætingu, matseðli, viðburðum og skilaboðum frá starfsfólki. Þú getur líka tilkynnt veikindi eða frí ef þú leyfir breytingar.
examples: Hvernig borðaði barnið mitt í hádeginu í vikunni?
Hvaða viðburðir eru fram undan í leikskólanum í þessum mánuði?
Láttu leikskólann vita að barnið mitt sé veikt í dag.
